name: classic
title: Classic editor support
notes: Archived rather than deleted: the warning and the after-the-fact notice both work and are covered by integration tests, but the browser half has no end-to-end test, because forcing the classic editor needs the Classic Editor plugin installed in the test environment. Restoring it means restoring that coverage first - see templates/features/classic/README.md. Explainer travels with it: it is the PHP-side wording of a change record, and the block editor does its own wording in TypeScript.
